title: Behavioral Assurance promotion gate
root_cause: Package validity, semantic behavioral validation, and operational certification can be represented as one undifferentiated promotion state.
source_requirement: Gate promotion with distinct maturity and typed evidence states.
implementation_steps: Define separate package, semantic behavior, operational, and external evidence gates.
Expose current maturity and missing next evidence.
negative_cases: Local evidence presented as external certification.
affected_tests: Capability maturity, evidence claims, skill catalog tests.
evidence_required: Promotion vectors for each maturity boundary and rejection reason.
rollback: Return promotion to package-only admission and mark higher claims unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Package validity, behavioral validation, and operational certification remain distinct.
